title.zh: 经济扩展奖励（先驱工业与先驱产品）（合并）命令
title.en: Economic Expansion Incentives (Pioneer Industries and Pioneer Products) (Consolidation) Order

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Economic Expansion Incentives (Relief from Income Tax) Act
(Chapter 86, Section 4)
Economic Expansion Incentives (Pioneer Industries and Pioneer Products) (Consolidation) Order
O 1
G.N. No. S 4096/1982
REVISED EDITION 1990
(25th March 1992)
Whereas by Gazette Notifications No. 3520 of 1st October 1982 and No. 3655 of 12th October 1984 notice was given respectively of the proposal to make an order declaring certain industries and products therein specified to be pioneer industries and pioneer products respectively:
And whereas no objections being received to such proposal the following orders were made:
The industries specified in the first column of the Schedule and the products specified against such industries in the second column of the Schedule shall be pioneer industries and pioneer products respectively for the purposes of the Economic Expansion Incentives (Relief from Income Tax) Act.

THE SCHEDULE
First column
Second column
Industry.
Products.
(1) (a) Non-metallic Mineral Products Manufacture
Abrasive and other Resin Bonded Products
(b) Manufacture of Equipment and Supplies
Medical and Scientific Equipment and Supplies.
4096/82
[12.11.82]
(2) Printing
Currency notes and other documents produced by similar high security printing process.
4578/84
[14.12.84]
